submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.888 ns across all tested configurations. This represents a substantial performance improvement of 28.9% over Mixture-G3 (1.249 ns) and 55.6% over Mixture-G2 (2.0 ns). The simulation data shows that Mixture-G1 consistently outperforms the other candidates at all gap widths tested (1mm, 2mm, and 3mm), with the optimal performance occurring at 2mm gap. This configuration meets all constraints: it uses one of the three candidate mixtures, the gap falls within the required 1-3mm range, and based on the documents reviewed, it complies with laboratory environmental and safety policies. The recommendation directly addresses the primary goal of achieving the best possible time resolution for the resistive-plate muon chamber upgrade.
